subject: Request: MLBench ramp — temporary headroom for throughput validation

Cc: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@calyxhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — MLBench ramp headroom for overnight validation

Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the MLBench run showed promising latency curves but we hit a hard cap on tokens during our simulated 3k-RPS soak late last night. The team is planning a controlled overnight ramp tonight (approx 6 hours) to validate p95 improvements with the newer batching profile and a KV cache warm start.

Request: can Redwood provision an ephemeral headroom top-up for our trial account to cover an additional 120k tokens (equivalent to ~18M tokens processed) between 00:00–06:00 PT tonight? We need the capacity to validate throughput scaling and p95 at the 2k–3k RPS range.

Attached is the run plan (mlbench-run-plan.pdf) and a small sample of the latency log from last night (latency-sample-20260410.txt). If you need exact billing estimates, Tom or I can take that separately; for now we mostly need a quick yes/no so the load team can proceed.

Thanks — Sarah

--
Sarah Park
Senior Engineering Manager
Calyx Health
sarah.park@calyxhealth.com

Subject: Re: Quick ask — MLBench ramp headroom for overnight validation

Sarah — got it. Appreciate the run plan; skimmed the attachment and the sample logs. We can support a short window like this but want to confirm a couple details before I lock it in:

- Exact window: you said 00:00–06:00 PT tonight. Confirming that's Pacific (UTC-7).
- Target sustained RPS: you mentioned 2k–3k; is the goal to hold 3k for any contiguous period, or short bursts to 3k?
- Model variant: do you want to run on the optimized quantized variant we demoed (redwood-quant-v2) or the higher-accuracy float variant? The quant path will be cheaper and lower latency but we need to know for routing/fallback policy.

Operationally: I can provision an ephemeral credit top-up as a promo allowance (no invoicing now) but we need a manager sign-off because it's outside standard trial limits. Marissa, looping you to approve a one-off 120k-token top-up that will only be valid for the requested window.

If approved I'll pass this to Ops to add the allowance and attach a short-lived dashboard link for you to watch host-level telemetry and token burn. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/CALX-8421 for visibility.

Ben

--

Ben / Sarah — approve a discretionary one-off top-up. Conditions below:

- Provision 120,000 token allowance limited to 2026-04-12 00:00 PT through 2026-04-12 06:00 PT.
- Limit redemption to the specified account (deal CALX-8421). No roll-over.
- Ops to enable a temporary model-routing policy pinned to redwood-quant-v2; if customer requests float variant during the window, escalate to sales@mng for additional approval.
- Customer to keep us posted in-thread if they need a second-night run; we can consider another discretionary grant but need the post-run telemetry first.

Ben — please generate a short approval note for records and confirm cost-approx for internal finance tracking. Vivek, can you handle the allocation and share dashboard link once done?

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — thank you, appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming:

- Window: 2026-04-12 00:00–06:00 PT (we'll start warm-up at 23:30 PT).
- Sustained target: steady 2k RPS with brief 2–3 minute bursts to 3k to reproduce the previous bottleneck.
- We'll run on redwood-quant-v2 as suggested; if the accuracy trade-off looks questionable we'll flag in the run notes and may request a short float run later.

I'll share a short Slack update with the load team. Tom will watch telemetry. Will post the post-run summary here for the discretionary second-night decision.

— Sarah
